speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: These waters are among the most productive fishing grounds in Arcadia.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: For generations, our communities have relied on bottom-trawling in this area to support our livelihoods and local food supplies.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: The area is also home to a diverse marine ecosystem that supports numerous fish species and marine mammals.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Construction activities could introduce underwater noise and habitat disturbance, placing pressure on marine biodiversity.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The proposed location offers favourable conditions for wind energy production and would contribute to Arcadia's renewable energy and climate objectives.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: However, building here may affect fishing livelihoods, food security, and marine ecosystems, raising concerns related to SDGs 1, 2, 8 and 14.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The Cabinet must determine whether the benefits of constructing the wind park in this location outweigh the potential social and environmental costs.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Should Arcadia proceed with construction at this site?
